subject: LSCI
title: Molecular Cell Biology
description: Organization and function of intracellular organelles in eukaryotic cells. Mechanisms of membrane transport. Protein sorting and vesicular transport. Cytoskeleton. DNA and chromosome structure. DNA replication. Mechanisms of RNA and protein synthesis. Control of gene expression. Cell cycle and the control of cell division. Mechanisms of cell communication and signal transduction. Apoptosis. Neuronal signaling.

prerequisites.text: LSCI 211 and FDSC 230 or equivalent, or permission of instructor.

subject: LSCI
title: Genetics
description: The course integrates classical, molecular and population genetics of animals, plants, bacteria and viruses. The aim is to understand the flow of genetic information within a cell, within families and in populations. Emphasis will be placed on problem solving based learning. The laboratory exercises will emphasize the interpretation of genetic experimental data.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken BIOL 202.

subject: LSCI
title: One Health Fundamentals
description: Foundational and guiding principles of One Health to better understand current and reflect on future challenges that are affecting various socio-economic and cultural groups. Fundamental concepts in One Health will be emphasized through core themes such as emerging and zoonotic pathogens, climate change, antimicrobial resistance, and global food system resilience.

subject: LSCI
title: Biochemistry 1
description: Biochemistry of carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, nucleic acids; enzymes and coenzymes. Introduction to intermediary metabolism.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken FDSC 211

subject: LSCI
title: Introductory Microbiology
description: The occurrence and importance of microorganisms in the biosphere. Principles governing growth, death and metabolic activities of microorganisms. An introduction to the microbiology of soil, water, plants, food, humans and animals.

subject: LSCI
title: Honours Research Project 1
description: Preparation of an honours research proposal, progress report, and delivery of a proposal seminar, as well as initiating the research project.

prerequisites.text: AEHM 205 and permission of the instructor

restrictions.text: Only open to students in the B.Sc.(Ag.Env.Sc.); Honours in Life Sciences (Biological and Agricultural) program.

notes: This course is only offered in Fall.

subject: LSCI
title: Honours Research Project 2
description: Completion of the honours research project, including a progress report, a final project report, and a project presentation.

prerequisites.text: LSCI 401 and permission of the instructor

restrictions.text: Only open to students in the B.Sc.(Ag.Env.Sc.); Honours in Life Sciences (Biological and Agricultural) program.

notes: This course is only offered in Winter.

subject: LSCI
title: Research Project 1
description: A research project on a topic relevant to the life sciences. This course is intended for senior (U3) undergraduates.

prerequisites.text: PARA 438 as a prerequisite or corequisite, and permission of instructor.

restrictions.text: Open to students with a minimum CGPA of 3.0.; Not open to students who have taken AEBI 451.

notes: Enrolment is limited by availability of research project supervisors and to students in the Life Sciences (Biological and Agricultural) Major. Students should make arrangements with a willing supervisor, and the proposed supervisor and project are subject to approval. Recommended for students in their final year (U3).

subject: LSCI
title: Research Project 2
description: Continuation of the project begun in LSCI 451 on a topic relevant to the life sciences.

restrictions.text: Enrolment is limited by availability of research project supervisors and to students in the Life Sciences (Biological and Agricultural) Major. Students should make arrangements with a supervisor; the proposed supervisor and project are subject to approval. Not open to students who have taken AEBI 452.
